title: 第28章 金法剑卷
novel_title: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
郁凌这两天虽然没有那么快进入新的学校，可他本就是处于一个爱玩的年龄，因为自己转校的事情，他得和那些好朋友好好道别。

    张刚打电话约他出去来一把，他便忍不住跑去和那群小伙伴们网吧一日游。

    郁凡回来后都没看到那小子，便知道那个臭小子没有好好修炼。

    可能修炼这种事情对于他们来说还是太遥远了，虽然有爷爷这个榜样在，可毕竟这不再是曾经兵荒马乱，缺粮少油的时代了。

    他们有自己想要做的事情，有自己的梦想，郁凡也不可能为了修炼让他们不顾如今的生活。

    叹了一口气便不想再管，随其自然吧。

    郁凡在前院的花园里开辟出来一小块地，以灵水灌养了一番，将自己储物空间内的一些带着根部易活的灵植给种在了这片土地上。

    过段时间就得教人家学习古医术，自己还是得先把一些药材准备好。

    这些药材都是异世界常见药材，对于基础的丹药的制造，可都是有大作用的，郁凡的想法无非就是能够大量的将这些药材在蓝星种植起来。

    这样就能大量炼制出一些常用丹药，想了想那些回春丹，祛毒丹，保颜丸等基础丹药的功效，这对于蓝星来说的，效果可想而知。

    郁景一脸茫然的找过来的时候，郁凡正在给自己新培植的药草小心的滴上灵液。

    看到郁景过来，郁凡停下手中的工作。

    神识扫过去，惊讶了一瞬，“引气入体了？”

    他倒是没有想到自己的孙子孙女中，两个资质上乘的还没先成功，反而资质中等的大孙子第一个完成引气入体。

    想到这孩子的性格，又似乎理所当然了。

    郁景是一个非常听话的孩子，让他修炼他不会有任何其他想法，而是一门心思的去不断的努力。

    修仙原本就靠得不仅仅是资质而已，资质很重要，可努力也很重要。

    不管做什么事情，天赋与努力都缺一不可。

    可以说这孩子未来若是能成功，也是必然的了。

    “爷爷，我照您所说的去修炼，现在能感受到身体里有气流的涌动，想问问您，我这样是成功了吗？”

    郁凡笑着说：“这就是成功的踏入了修仙的门槛了，没想到你们三兄妹中，你会是第一个引气入体成功的。”
content_en:
Although Yu Ling did not enter a new school so quickly in the past two days, he was at a fun-loving age. Because of his transfer, he had to say goodbye to his good friends.

Zhang just called and asked him to go out, so he couldn't help but go to the Internet cafe for a day trip with his friends.

Yu Fan didn't even see the boy after he came back, so he knew that the brat didn't practice well.

Maybe cultivation is still too far away for them. Although their grandfather is a role model, after all, this is no longer the era of war, food and oil shortage.

They have their own things they want to do and their own dreams, and it is impossible for Yu Fan to let them ignore their current lives for the sake of cultivation.

I sighed and didn't want to worry about it anymore, just let it be.

Yu Fan opened up a small piece of land in the front yard garden, irrigated it with spiritual water, and planted some spiritual plants with easy-to-live roots in his storage space on the land.

After a while, I will have to teach others ancient medical techniques, and I still have to prepare some medicinal materials first.

These medicinal materials are all common medicinal materials in other worlds, and they are of great use in the production of basic elixirs. Yu Fan's idea is simply to plant a large number of these medicinal materials in Blue Star.

In this way, some commonly used elixirs can be refined in large quantities. Considering the effects of basic elixirs such as rejuvenation pills, detoxification pills, and beauty pills, the effect for Blue Star can be imagined.

When Yu Jing came over with a confused look on his face, Yu Fan was carefully dripping spiritual liquid on his newly cultivated herbs.

Seeing Yu Jing coming, Yu Fan stopped what he was doing.

His consciousness swept over and he was surprised for a moment, "Has the Qi been introduced into the body?"

He did not expect that among his grandchildren, the two with the best qualifications had not succeeded first, but the eldest grandson with the average qualifications was the first to complete the introduction of Qi into the body.

Thinking about this child's character, it seems natural.

Yu Jing is a very obedient child. When he is asked to practice, he will not have any other thoughts, but will focus on his continuous efforts.

Cultivation of immortality originally depends on more than just qualifications. Qualifications are very important, but hard work is also very important.

No matter what you do, talent and hard work are indispensable.

It can be said that if this child can succeed in the future, it is inevitable.

"Grandpa, I practiced as you said, and now I can feel the surge of air in my body. I want to ask you, have I succeeded?"

Yu Fan smiled and said, "This is the moment you have successfully entered the threshold of cultivating immortality. I never thought that among the three brothers and sisters, you would be the first to successfully introduce Qi into your body."
